branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A trade-marked, soft washed-rind cheese of cow's milk, made at a dairy in Brochon, Côte-d'Or. It is ripened at least four weeks, and its rind is washed with water and marc de Bourgogne, which gives an orange rind and a strong aroma.

sources.text: The milk, washing, ripening, trademark and place, from this article.
